title: Communication Terminal Startup Signal Open Circuit
detail_of_failure: Since the voltage of the communication terminal power output line from the gateway function controller is 5.7 V or less while the command is OFF, an open circuit is detected.
controller_action: • Does not turn ON the start signal of the communication terminal. • Even after the cause of failure is corrected, the machine will not return to normal until the starting switch is turned to the OFF position.
machine_effect: The KOMTRAX system does not operate normally.

steps.procedure: 1. See Related Information to Troubleshooting, Checks Before Troubleshooting, Electrical Components. Check according to the descriptions of wiring harnesses and connectors. 2. Are the wiring harness and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harness and connectors are normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The wiring harness or a connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to confirmation of repair.

steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Disconnect the connector CK06, and connect the T-adapter to the male side. 3. Measure the resistance. 4. Does the troubleshooting result agree with the standard value?

branches.YES: • The communication terminal connector is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The communication terminal connector is defective. • Repair or replace the communication terminal connector. • Go to confirmation of repair.

steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Disconnect the connectors CK05 and CK06 and connect the T-adapter to each female side. 3. Measure the resistance. 4. branches.NO: • The gateway function controller can be defective. • Replace the gateway function controller. • Go to confirmation of repair.

steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Connect all the component parts. 3. Turn the starting switch to the ON position to troubleshoot. 4. Is this failure code shown?
